summary: community.proxmox's proxmox module adds a ca_path option to specify a CA certificate for TLS validation.
questions: How do I use a custom CA certificate with the proxmox module?

answer_card.title: proxmox ca_path option
answer_card.answer_md: The `community.proxmox.proxmox` module has a new **`ca_path`** option to specify a CA certificate for TLS validation.
